description: Service boundary definitions for the International Wire Transfer (Corporate) journey. Documents which service owns which entity and event, responsibilities within this journey, and how services interact. Cross-capability communication is exclusively async events via SVC-102. SVC-010 (International Payments, CAP-003) may call SVC-009 (Domestic Payments, CAP-003) directly as a same-capability synchronous call. No other capability calls are synchronous.
architectural_principle: Cross-capability communication is exclusively async events. Within a capability, services communicate freely.

services.new_service_rationale: SVC-010 is introduced by JRN-009. CAP-003.04 (International Payments) met all four promotion criteria and is a distinct service from SVC-009 (Domestic Payments). SVC-010 owns the full international payment lifecycle: FX quotation, correspondent routing selection, SWIFT message assembly (ISO 20022 pacs.008), SWIFT network submission, and gpi tracking.
services.role_in_journey: Primary orchestrator of the international wire transfer lifecycle. Owns ENT-026, ENT-027, ENT-028, ENT-029. Validates transfer at initiation. Obtains FX quotation. Triggers cross-capability compliance checks via async events. Assembles SWIFT pacs.008 message. Submits to SWIFT network. Publishes transfer lifecycle events. May call SVC-009 directly (same capability) for nostro account settlement mechanics.

consumed_events.name: TransferSanctionsScreened
consumed_events.purpose: PH-031: Receives sanctions screening outcome for beneficiary and correspondent chain. If outcome = hit: sets InternationalTransfer.status = sanctions_blocked; publishes TransferFailed (EVT-057). If outcome = clear: records result; waits for EVT-052 before publishing TransferCleared.

consumed_events.name: TransferFraudScored
consumed_events.purpose: PH-031: Receives fraud score for the international transfer. If risk_level = block: sets InternationalTransfer.status = fraud_blocked; publishes TransferFailed (EVT-057). If non-block: records fraud_score; waits for EVT-051 before publishing TransferCleared. Correlation map keyed on transfer_id — both EVT-051 and EVT-052 must arrive before proceeding.

consumed_apis.purpose: SVC-010 calls SVC-009 for nostro account settlement mechanics (debit of the bank's nostro account at the correspondent bank). Same-capability direct call permitted per architectural principles. Not on the critical path for the customer-facing transfer outcome.
Dispatch customer notifications: transfer confirmation, FX quote (if cross-currency), sanctions block decline (generic text only), fraud block decline, transfer completion.

consumed_apis.call_pattern: Synchronous submission; asynchronous acknowledgement and gpi tracker callbacks
consumed_apis.purpose: PH-033: SVC-010 submits assembled pacs.008 to the SWIFT network via SAA Cloud. Receives synchronous submission acknowledgement and async gpi tracker updates (ACSP, ACCC) as webhooks.

PH-030: SVC-010 calls the FX pricing engine (intra-capability) synchronously to obtain indicative or firm FX rate. The pricing engine is an internal component of CAP-003 — not a cross-capability call. Timeout: 1 second. On timeout: indicative mid-market rate applied with enhanced spread as fallback.

PH-029: SVC-010 calls SVC-100 (via the channel) to validate FIDO2/WebAuthn SCA assertion with dynamic linking (beneficiary IBAN, amount, currency). Also validates dual-authorisation SCA for the second authoriser where applicable.

decision_logic.compliance_cleared_condition: EVT-051.outcome = clear AND EVT-052.risk_level in (low | medium | high) — i.e. not block
decision_logic.sanctions_blocked_condition: EVT-051.outcome = hit on any screened entity
decision_logic.timeout_behaviour: If either EVT-051 or EVT-052 is not received within 30 seconds of EVT-049 publication, SVC-010 sets InternationalTransfer.status = compliance_timeout and alerts Payment Operations. Fail-closed: transfer does not proceed.
decision_logic.correlation_note: SVC-010 maintains a correlation map keyed on transfer_id to track receipt of both compliance events.

services.role_in_journey: Owns BusinessAccount (ENT-B002) and BusinessCustomer (ENT-B001). Executes the account debit on the originating BusinessAccount when SVC-010 publishes SWIFTMessageSent (EVT-054) — cross-capability async consumption. Publishes an intra-CAP-002 event (BusinessAccountDebited) that is not a JRN-009 journey event. No new entities or events introduced to SVC-005 by JRN-009.

consumed_events.name: SWIFTMessageSent
consumed_events.purpose: PH-033: SVC-005 consumes SWIFTMessageSent to execute the debit of BusinessAccount.balance by InternationalTransfer.gbp_equivalent. Idempotent on transfer_id. SVC-005 validates that the debit has not already been applied (prevents duplicate debit on redelivery).

services.role_in_journey: Stateless cross-capability screening service. Consumes InternationalTransferInitiated (EVT-049) and runs sanctions screens against: beneficiary name + IBAN + BIC; and each BIC in CorrespondentRouting.correspondent_chain. For JRN-009 this is a multi-entity fan-out screen (up to 6 entities: 1 beneficiary + up to 5 correspondent banks). Publishes TransferSanctionsScreened (EVT-051) with a single consolidated outcome after all entity screens complete.
services.stateless_note: SVC-051 owns no entities. Screening results are logged to SVC-103 (OFSI audit obligation) and referenced via a result_id in EVT-051.

consumed_events.name: InternationalTransferInitiated
consumed_events.purpose: PH-031: Triggers sanctions screening of beneficiary (name, IBAN, BIC) and correspondent chain BICs. SVC-051 performs concurrent fan-out screens against OFSI, UN, EU, and OFAC lists. Consolidated outcome published as EVT-051.

screening_entities_for_international: Each BIC in CorrespondentRouting.correspondent_chain — available after PH-032, but CorrespondentRouting is assembled using the beneficiary BIC which SVC-010 pre-loads into EVT-049 payload
business_customer_id — for payer-side sanctions re-verification (ongoing monitoring per GOV-005-R02)
services.jrn009_extension_note: JRN-009 extends SVC-051 with multi-entity fan-out screening for the correspondent chain. JRN-001 and JRN-002 screened only one entity per event. JRN-009 requires screening of up to 6 entities concurrently from a single EVT-049 trigger. SVC-051 internal parallelism handles this — no schema change to the external EVT-051 event (consolidated outcome only).

services.role_in_journey: Cross-capability fraud scoring service. Consumes InternationalTransferInitiated (EVT-049) and scores the transfer using a corporate wire fraud ML model (distinct from the retail FPS model used in JRN-002). Publishes TransferFraudScored (EVT-052) with risk_score, risk_level, and model_version.
services.stateless_note: SVC-013 owns no new entities for JRN-009. The fraud score is provided via EVT-052 payload and stored on ENT-026 (InternationalTransfer.fraud_score_ref) by SVC-010.

consumed_events.name: InternationalTransferInitiated
consumed_events.purpose: PH-031: Triggers corporate wire fraud scoring. SVC-013 evaluates: transfer amount (absolute and relative to account history); beneficiary jurisdiction risk; time of day; channel; user session metadata; recent transfer patterns for the business_customer_id.

fraud_scoring_features_international: Transfer amount (absolute GBP equivalent and relative to account 90-day average)
Beneficiary jurisdiction (FATF high-risk third country flag, sanctioned jurisdiction flag)
Beneficiary BIC — first use vs established correspondent
Purpose code plausibility (amount vs purpose code expected range)
Time of day and day of week (unusual submission patterns)
Corporate portal session metadata (device fingerprint, IP geolocation)
User account history — is this user an established authoriser for international transfers?
Velocity — number of international transfers in last 24h / 7 days for this business account

services.role_in_journey: Same-capability support service. SVC-010 may call SVC-009 directly (synchronous, same-capability CAP-003 call) for nostro account settlement mechanics. SVC-009 does not publish or consume any JRN-009 events. No new entities introduced by JRN-009 in SVC-009.
services.same_capability_call_note: SVC-010 calls SVC-009 synchronously (same CAP-003 capability — direct call permitted) to instruct the nostro account debit. This is an internal payment operations settlement step, not visible to the customer and not modelled as a cross-capability event.

cross_service_interaction_summary.description: PER-002 submits transfer via CH-003 (corporate portal). Channel calls SVC-100 for SCA validation, then SVC-010 POST /international-transfers. SVC-010 creates ENT-026 (InternationalTransfer, status = pending_compliance) and publishes EVT-049 (InternationalTransferInitiated).

SVC-010 detects cross-currency requirement. Calls internal FX pricing engine (intra-capability synchronous). Creates ENT-027 (FXQuotation). Presents quote to customer. On acceptance: updates InternationalTransfer.fx_rate and gbp_equivalent. Publishes EVT-050 (FXQuoteProvided). GBP transfers skip this step.

EVT-049 consumed concurrently by SVC-051 (sanctions) and SVC-013 (fraud). SVC-051 fans out screens to all entities; publishes EVT-051 (TransferSanctionsScreened). SVC-013 scores transfer; publishes EVT-052 (TransferFraudScored). SVC-010 waits for both events (correlation map on transfer_id). Both clear: continues. Any block: publishes EVT-057 (TransferFailed).
SVC-010 creates ENT-028 (CorrespondentRouting) and ENT-029 (SWIFTMessage). Assembles pacs.008 with UETR assigned. Sets InternationalTransfer.gpi_uetr. Publishes EVT-053 (TransferCleared).

SVC-010 submits pacs.008 to SWIFT via SAA Cloud. Publishes EVT-054 (SWIFTMessageSent). SVC-005 (CAP-002, async) consumes EVT-054 and debits BusinessAccount. SVC-010 calls SVC-009 directly (same-capability) for nostro settlement. On correspondent ACK: publishes EVT-055 (CorrespondentAcknowledged).

SVC-010 receives SWIFT gpi tracker updates. On ACCC (final credit confirmed): sets InternationalTransfer.status = completed. Publishes EVT-056 (TransferCompleted). SVC-053 dispatches customer notification. SVC-103 and SVC-111 archive audit trail.
